kickoff.title: Proof of Restraint — kickoff: ADR + living plan
kickoff.goal: Lock the Proof-of-Restraint design as a binding ADR and confirm the living PLAN/LOG are the single source of truth for this feature.
instructions: Read docs/proof-of-restraint/PLAN.md end to end, plus code/aiosh-cli/src/audit.ts, code/aiosh-cli/src/pep.ts and code/aiosh-rust/aiosh-core/src/pep_grant*.rs.
Write mostimportanAIfolder/ADR-0037-proof-of-restraint.md capturing the threat model (operator can rewrite an un-anchored chain), the three layers, and the invariants I-1..I-5 from PLAN.md.
Correct anything in PLAN.md that the code reading proved wrong; record each correction in the PLAN.md Change log with the reason.
Run bash ci/run_all_smokes.sh and confirm the baseline is green before any implementation task in this block.
Append a kickoff entry to docs/proof-of-restraint/LOG.md.
acceptance: ADR-0037 exists and is linked from PLAN.md.
PLAN.md reflects the verified current code, with a dated Change log entry.
Baseline smokes green; LOG.md has a kickoff entry.

focus.capability mint/redeem records: Feature focus: every grant issue writes a `pep.capability.mint` audit row and every use writes exactly one `pep.capability.redeem` row referencing the same token (PLAN.md §Layer 1, invariant I-1). Keep TS, Python and Rust canonical-JSON parity.
focus.redeem-before-act gate: Feature focus: a consequential tool must be unreachable unless a redeem row is committed first (PLAN.md invariant I-2). Enumerate every dispatch path (CLI, MCP, agent loop, Rust core) and prove none bypasses the gate.
focus.chain anchoring & completeness checkpoin: Feature focus: periodically sign the chain head (seq, hash, ts) with a key the audit DB never holds and store it outside audit.db (PLAN.md §Layer 2, invariant I-3). A rewritten chain must fail verification against the anchors.
focus.restraint proof generator: Feature focus: `aiosh prove restraint --cap <cap> --since <window>` plus the matching MCP tool emit a self-contained proof file (PLAN.md §Proof format). Reuse audit segment bloom filters for archived ranges.
focus.standalone proof verifier: Feature focus: a verifier that trusts ONLY the proof file plus the public anchor key, with no access to audit.db (PLAN.md invariant I-4). Must reject truncated, re-chained and wrong-window proofs.
focus.continuous restraint conformance: Feature focus: a conformance smoke wired into ci/run_all_smokes.sh that fails when any new consequential path skips redemption or anchors go stale (PLAN.md invariant I-5). This is what keeps the feature alive after this block closes.

pre: Read docs/proof-of-restraint/PLAN.md (sections for '{component}') before starting; it overrides generic wording below when they conflict.
post: Append a dated entry to docs/proof-of-restraint/LOG.md (task id T-{task_id:05d}, what changed, files touched, tests run).
If anything forced a design change, edit docs/proof-of-restraint/PLAN.md and record what changed and why in its Change log.

closing.title: Proof of Restraint — milestone close & live demo
closing.goal: Prove the feature end to end and hand it over to the standing rules that keep it maintained.
instructions: Run the demo from PLAN.md §Demo: mint a capability, leave it unused, generate a restraint proof, verify it with the standalone verifier; then tamper (delete a row, re-chain) and show verification fails.
Update docs/tasks/GOALS.md 'What is already done' and task_plan.md with the shipped capability.
Mark PLAN.md status as 'Shipped — maintained by standing rules' and add a final LOG.md entry.
acceptance: Demo passes and the tamper case fails verification, both captured as evidence.
GOALS.md, task_plan.md, PLAN.md and LOG.md updated.

standing_rules.instruction: [PoR] Proof-of-Restraint standing rule: if this component adds or changes any state-changing path, confirm it cannot execute without redeeming a capability token (docs/proof-of-restraint/PLAN.md invariant I-2) and record the check in the security evidence.
[PoR] Run the Proof-of-Restraint conformance smoke and anchor verification; if this component touched grants, audit, PEP or dispatch, append an entry to docs/proof-of-restraint/LOG.md.
